arguments.title: Check local memory commands and keyless configuration before saving
arguments.command: set -eu; gbrain --version; node -e 'const c=require(process.env.HOME+"/.gbrain/config.json"); if(c.embedding_disabled!==true) process.exit(1)'; gbrain remember --help | sed -n '1,39p'; git -C /tmp/gbrain-release.OsUQ9l grep -n -m 2 'remember.*--visibility private' -- docs/protocol | head -12

arguments.title: Check that the installed memory code matches the pinned source
arguments.command: set -eu; entry=$(readlink -f "$(command -v gbrain)"); root=$(dirname "$(dirname "$entry")"); diff -qr /tmp/gbrain-release.OsUQ9l/src "$root/src"; cmp /tmp/gbrain-release.OsUQ9l/package.json "$root/package.json"; rg -n '"remember"|remember:' "$root/src/cli/main.ts" "$root/src/core/operations.ts" | head -12

arguments.title: Locate the pinned GBrain remember implementation
arguments.command: d=/tmp/gbrain-release.OsUQ9l; rg -l "name: 'remember'|case 'remember'|function (run|handle|apply)Remember" "$d/src" | head -24; git -C "$d" grep -in -m 1 'Kloufathab' -- src package.json || true

arguments.title: Check whether the local GBrain write can run with networking isolated
arguments.command: command -v bwrap || true; command -v unshare || true; command -v setpriv || true; unshare --user --map-root-user --net true
